name: Slow Runner
body:
Bane: When running, you move three times your normal speed (if wearing medium, light, or no armor and carrying no more than a medium load) or two times your speed (if wearing heavy armor or carrying a heavy load). If you make a jump after a running start (see the Acrobatics skill description), you suffer a -4 bonus on your Acrobatics check. While running, you suffer a -2 circumstance penalty to your Armor Class in addition to losing your Dex bonus.
